payload.title: Isolate wrapped local namespaces in canonical module declaration lookup (B-0050 prerequisite)
payload.summary: Related canonical prerequisite for unresolved B-0049/B-0050 facade repair. Offline exact B-0050 candidate reproduction shows its repaired consumer guard prunes conditional-local imports, but canonical modules/declarations.py independently walks into local bodies and returns ambiguity. Repair ONLY this canonical owner; keep the original facade consumer defect and parent obligations open. Preserve direct target/source provenance and genuine module stores, declarations, imports, aliases, patterns, handlers, star/dynamic conservatism. One supervised model-authored continuation; no reference implementation, automatic installation or closure.

This item is a related prerequisite, not a duplicate independent obligation or completion of the parent. Public tests disclose the prior revealed failure category; private holdouts use separately authored non-import binding/provenance distinctions. Bounded acceptance is not exhaustive Python semantics.
